hypothesis: list_user_trips tool lacks strict dual-ownership validation (created_by and trip_members), risking either leaking unauthorized trips to third-party callers or failing to discover legitimate collaborator trips.

get_trip_itinerary tool lacks broken-object-level-authorization (BOLA) guards, allowing an attacker with a valid session token to inspect other travelers' private itinerary nodes and notes by guessing or probing trip_id.

manage_itinerary_node lacks physical bounding checks on AI-supplied lat/lng coordinates (allowing NaN, Null Island, or out-of-range coords to corrupt the WebGL map), lacks day_index boundaries exceeding total_days, and lacks incremental sort_order on batch insertions.

MCP server omits the RFC 9728 /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource endpoint required by the Model Context Protocol 2026-07-28 specification, causing strict 2026 clients to fail authorization server discovery.
